sessions.tips:
This week we bring the heat.
Expect higher heart rate, more volume, and muscle endurance under fatigue, while still chasing strength and power.

You’ll rotate through three AMRAPs, combining compound lifts with explosive and core elements to build capacity and resilience.
It’s not just about moving weight, it’s about doing it with control, consistency, and elevated effort.

On the run:
We’re mixing longer efforts with fast 100m repeats to develop threshold pacing under pressure.
Use the 1600s to find rhythm and control, attack the short intervals with focus.
Don’t just survive the volume, manage your effort, and finish strong.

This is your last chance to develop these specific lifts before we shift focus. Today, we’re touching 95% on squats and deadlifts, the highest loads you’ll see all season. So take the time to warm up properly, respect your body, and load with intent.

The run is all about precision under pressure.
Each interval is based on your 300m time, maintain the pace with no rest between reps. It’s short, sharp, and demands full focus. Track your 300m time and stay disciplined with your pacing.

Lift heavy. Run smart. Finish the block strong.
